name: Heroine wa Tomodachi Desu ka? Koibito Desu ka? Soretomo Tomefure Desu ka? Second
original_name: 彼女は友達ですか？　恋人ですか？　それともトメフレですか？ Second
source:
Tomefure is a new kind of friend relationship between students in which boy gives runaway girls in trouble free housing. Main character lives alone at a big house, so he goes to the site and opens reservations. To his surprise, all the volunteers are his beautiful classmates. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2021/12/vn-of-month-september-2021-fuyukara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“寄宿友”是一种学生之间的新型交友关系，男生为遇到麻烦、离家出走的女孩提供免费住处。主角独自住在一栋大房子里，于是前往网站，开放了入住申请。令他惊讶的是，报名的人竟然全是漂亮的同班同学。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2021/12/vn-of-month-september-2021-fuyukara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
